title: Spicy Ethiopian Stew
description: A flavorful and spicy stew inspired by Ethiopian cuisine. This dish is perfect for a chilly evening and can be served with a side of rice or injera.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add berbere spice and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add roasted peanuts and cook for an additional 2 minutes, stirring frequently.
Add chicken broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in coconut milk and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add fresh spinach and cook until wilted.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot with a side of rice or injera.
